newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Rand Mines shareholders approve unbundling.
newsitem.headline: Rand Mines shareholders approve unbundling.

text.p: Rand Mines Ltd announced on Tuesday that its shareholders had approved resolutions necessary to unbundle the company.
As a result, the unbundling of the company would become unconditional on November 13 and would become operative on November 18.

Trading in the company's shares on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange and the London Stock Exchange would be suspended from the close of business on November 13 and the company's listings would be terminated on November 15.
The company said a further announcement would be made around November 14.
